messages:
Riley: Quick ask — what's one tiny, kinda dumb ritual you do before coffee that makes the morning feel...official?
Maya: I tap my mug three times like it's a drum. No idea why. :coffee:
Diego: I open the fridge, stare until something good appears, then close it and get tea.
Priya: I whistle one note. If I hit it, I say it's going to be a good day. If not, I start again.
Sam: I line up three pens on my desk in order of shade. If a pen is out of line, chaos. :sweat_smile:
Alex: I slap the keyboard lid twice before opening. Heard it on youtube, now it's ritual.
Riley: Love the pen alignment. I always water my tiny succulent and name the droplet after yesterday's highlight.
Maya: @Sam omg the pen thing. My partner judges but it's calming.
OpsBot: Reminder: snack drawer restocked. :package:
Diego: Also: I rotate my chair to face the window for 10 seconds. Sun-check.
Priya: This thread made me realize mine is clapping my hands once and saying "let's go" under breath.
Sam: Okay new company policy: all pen misalignments earn a :point_up: from Riley.
Riley: Deal. Whoever brings a real-life photo of their "ritual" gets a :cookie:.
